content: Using the combination of dual training and shared variable projections, we train a 12-layer highly-compressed student BERT model, achieving a maximum compression ratio of $\sim $61.94x (with 48 dimension size) compared to the teacher BERTBASE model. We conduct experiments for measuring both generalized language modeling perspective and for downstream tasks, demonstrating competitive performance with high compression ratios for both families of tasks.
